items.question: What is rented at La Grimouillière?
items.answer: The rental is the little house — an independent home with its own garden and no facing view — located within the grounds of La Grimouillière.

items.question: How many guests can the house welcome?
What are the main living spaces?
items.answer: On the ground floor, the dining room with fireplace is the common living space of the house. It is extended by a living room with a large table, ideal for reading, spending time together and remote working.

items.question: Is the house suitable for families?
items.answer: Yes — the layout is particularly convenient for a couple with children, thanks to the adjoining room with two single beds upstairs.

items.question: Is the boudoir a bedroom?
items.answer: The boudoir is on the ground floor. It is not a main bedroom, but a flexible extra room with a TV that can be used as an additional sleeping space when needed.

items.question: How many bathrooms and WCs are there?
items.answer: One bathroom upstairs, plus two fully independent WCs: one on the ground floor and one upstairs.

items.question: Can I work remotely from the little house?
items.answer: Yes. The house benefits from high-speed Starlink Wi-Fi across the whole property, and the living room offers a large table particularly well suited to remote working.

items.question: Is the pool accessible?
items.answer: Yes, the pool is accessible from 1pm to 6pm, from May to end of September.

items.question: How do I check exact availability?
items.answer: Please send us a message with your travel dates.
